items.title: Charles Lloyd — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: It was full of Ansel Adams photos and all kinds of stuff.

ctx.x: Of course. So anyway one day a girl was taking a flute lesson from me and she said, “You see that house down there on that point?” It was all glass and stone and steel and stuff, beautiful like - what’s that guy’s name? Howard Rourke vision of fantasy of something. And I said, “Yeah.” She said - Cause I was living on the ocean too, she pointed down at a point sticking out called Partying Point. She said, “That’s where my property is. I’m custodian up on the chief’s hill.” She said, “It’s thirteen acres.” You…
